Name: coaster
CardText: Climb a 19-meter lift hill, drop at up to 62 km/h (39 mph), then loop upside down.
CardNote: Fast and loopy. Gentle ride goes at half speed. Drag to look around.
About: The Comet Coaster climbs a 19-meter lift hill, drops toward the grass at up to 62 km/h, then flips you through a loop. Want to ride?
Stats: The lift hill is about 19 meters tall, the loop is about 10 meters tall, and the top speed is about 62 km/h (39 mph). The track is about 170 meters long.
Safety: It’s a virtual ride, so you’re safe, but it can feel fast. Pick Gentle ride for a slower version, and tap Exit ride any time.

Name: drop
CardText: Rise about 30 meters for a view of the whole campus, then drop back down.
CardNote: A big drop. Gentle ride lowers you slowly. Drag to look around.
About: The Sky Drop lifts you about 30 meters up, high enough to see the whole campus, then drops you back down.
Stats: The Sky Drop tower is about 34 meters tall. The seats ride up to about 30 meters, then free-fall at up to about 68 km/h before the brakes kick in.
Safety: It’s a virtual ride, so you’re safe, but it can feel fast. Pick Gentle ride for a slower version, and tap Exit ride any time.

Name: dive
CardText: Swim past a coral reef and through a kelp forest, with fish schools, a sea turtle, a whale shark, a manta ray and jellyfish.
CardNote: A calm, guided swim that takes about a minute. Drag to look around, and tap sea creatures to learn about them.
About: The Ocean Dive is a guided swim past a coral reef and a kelp forest, with fish schools, a sea turtle, a whale shark, a manta ray and jellyfish. It’s inspired by ocean VR like Hydrous, a partner listed by XRLibraries.
Stats: The dive goes down to about 12 meters deep and takes about a minute. It’s a calm, slow swim.
Safety: The Ocean Dive is calm and slow, and nothing down there will hurt you. You can pause or surface any time.
